CLIPLoader.name: CLIPLoader
CLIPLoader.description:
Recipes:
sd: clip-l
stable cascade: clip-g
sd3: t5 xxl / clip-g / clip-l
stable audio: t5 base
mochi: t5 xxl
cogvideox: t5 xxl (226-token padding)
cosmos: old t5 xxl
lumina2: gemma 2 2B
wan: umt5 xxl
hidream: llama-3.1 (Recommend) or t5
omnigen2: qwen vl 2.5 3B
joyimage: qwen3-vl 8B
lens: gpt-oss-20b
pixeldit: gemma 2 2B elm
minimax: MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL or Music3 Qwen/RVQ

DualCLIPLoader.name: DualCLIPLoader
DualCLIPLoader.description:
Recipes:
sdxl: clip-l, clip-g
sd3: clip-l, clip-g / clip-l, t5 / clip-g, t5
flux: clip-l, t5
hidream: at least one of t5 or llama, recommended t5 and llama
hunyuan_image: qwen2.5vl 7b and byt5 small
newbie: gemma-3-4b-it, jina clip v2

LoraLoaderModelOnly.name: LoraLoaderModelOnly
LoraLoaderModelOnly.description: This LoRAs loader is used to modify the diffusion model, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.

model.tooltip: The diffusion model the LoRA will be applied to.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model the LoRA will be applied to.

strength_model.tooltip: How strongly to modify the diffusion model. This value can be negative.

strength_clip.tooltip: How strongly to modify the CLIP model. This value can be negative.

LoraLoader.name: LoraLoader
LoraLoader.description: This LoRA loader is used to modify both diffusion and CLIP models, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

CLIPTextEncode.name: CLIPTextEncode
CLIPTextEncode.description: Encodes a text prompt using a CLIP model into an embedding that can be used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.
output_tooltips: A conditioning containing the embedded text used to guide the diffusion model.

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

sampler_name.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

KSampler.name: KSampler
KSampler.description: Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.

vae.tooltip: The VAE model used for decoding the latent.

VAEDecode.name: VAEDecode
VAEDecode.description: Decodes latent images back into pixel space images.

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes.

SaveImage.name: SaveImage
SaveImage.description: Saves the input images to your ComfyUI output directory.

PreviewImage.name: PreviewImage
PreviewImage.description: Preview the images without saving them to the ComfyUI output directory.

ReferenceLatent.name: ReferenceLatent
ReferenceLatent.description: This node sets the guiding latent for an edit model. If the model supports it you can chain multiple to set multiple reference images.

noise_mask.tooltip: Add a noise mask to the latent so sampling will only happen within the mask. Might improve results or completely break things depending on the model.

temporal_size.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to decode at a time.

temporal_overlap.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to overlap.

class_name.tooltip: Filter detections by class. Set to 'all' to disable filtering.

max_detections.tooltip: Maximum number of detections to return per image. In order of descending confidence score.

bboxes.tooltip: Optional bounding boxes for more accurate detections. Required for multi-person detection.

output_tooltips: Keypoints in OpenPose frame format (canvas_width, canvas_height, people)
SDPoseKeypointExtractor.name: SDPoseKeypointExtractor
SDPoseKeypointExtractor.description: Extract pose keypoints from images using the SDPose model: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/SDPose/tree/main/checkpoints

PreviewAny.name: PreviewAny
PreviewAny.description: Preview any input value as text.

ckpt_name.tooltip: The name of the checkpoint (model) to load.

CheckpointLoaderSimple.name: CheckpointLoaderSimple
CheckpointLoaderSimple.description: Loads a diffusion model checkpoint, diffusion models are used to denoise latents.
output_tooltips: The model used for denoising latents.
The CLIP model used for encoding text prompts.
The VAE model used for encoding and decoding images to and from latent space.

refine_iterations.tooltip: SAM decoder refinement passes (0=use raw detector masks)

individual_masks.tooltip: Output per-object masks instead of union

positive_coords.tooltip: Positive point prompts as JSON [{"x": int, "y": int}, ...] (pixel coords)

negative_coords.tooltip: Negative point prompts as JSON [{"x": int, "y": int}, ...] (pixel coords)

width.tooltip: Width of the canvas and the pixel grid for the bounding boxes.

height.tooltip: Height of the canvas and the pixel grid for the bounding boxes.

editor_state.tooltip: Draw bounding boxes and set each box type, text, description, color palette. Start with background element first and foreground last.

background.tooltip: Optional image used as background in the canvas and preview.

bboxes.tooltip: Bounding boxes, elements, or a JSON string to initialize the canvas. A new upstream value initializes the canvas; edits made on the canvas take priority and are kept until the upstream value changes again.

last_incoming.tooltip: Internal state managed by the canvas: the upstream bboxes value that last initialized it. Leave empty to re-initialize the canvas from the bboxes input on the next run.

CreateBoundingBoxes.name: CreateBoundingBoxes
CreateBoundingBoxes.description: Draw bounding boxes in a canvas. Outputs Ideogram prompt elements, pixel-space bounding boxes, and a preview image.

bg_removal_name.tooltip: The model used to remove backgrounds from images

bg_removal_model.tooltip: Background removal model used to generate the mask

image.tooltip: Input image to remove the background from

RemoveBackground.name: RemoveBackground
RemoveBackground.description: Generates a foreground mask to remove the background from an image using a background removal model.

image.tooltip: The image to encode (1 = regenerate region comes from the mask).

mask.tooltip: Inpainting mask [H, W] (1 = regenerate, 0 = keep). Snapped to the latent size automatically.

LanPaint_ImageEncode.name: LanPaint_ImageEncode
LanPaint_ImageEncode.description: Encode an image and attach an inpainting mask to the latent (replaces VAEEncode + SetLatentNoiseMask).

image.tooltip: The original image. When given, the decoded output is resized to its exact dimensions.

mask.tooltip: The inpainting mask (1 = take the inpainted pixels, 0 = keep the original).

blend_overlap.tooltip: Boundary blend width in pixels between the inpainted and original image (MaskBlend-style).

LanPaint_ImageDecode.name: LanPaint_ImageDecode
LanPaint_ImageDecode.description: Decode an inpainted latent, resize to the original image's exact dimensions, and merge with the original inside the mask (replaces VAEDecode + MaskBlend).

LanPaint_NumSteps.tooltip: Number of steps for Langevin dynamics, representing turns of thinking per step.

LanPaint_Lambda.tooltip: Bidirectional guidance scale. Higher values align with known regions but may cause instability.

LanPaint_StepSize.tooltip: Step size for Langevin dynamics. Higher values speed convergence but may be unstable.

LanPaint_PromptMode.tooltip: Image First: prioritizes image quality; Prompt First: prioritizes prompt adherence.

LanPaint_Info.tooltip: For more info, visit https://github.com/scraed/LanPaint. If you find it useful, please give a star ⭐️!

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

LanPaint_NumSteps.tooltip: The number of steps for the Langevin dynamics, representing the turns of thinking per step.

LanPaint_PromptMode.tooltip: Image First: emphasis image quality, Prompt First: emphasis prompt following

LanPaint_Info.tooltip: For more info, visit https://github.com/scraed/LanPaint. If you find it useful, please give a star ⭐️!

Inpainting_mode.tooltip: Choose Image mode for photos or Video mode for video frames with temporal consistency

LanPaint_KSampler.name: LanPaint_KSampler
LanPaint_KSampler.description: Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.

ref_pad_image.tooltip: Fills the padding frames of the image conditioning with this image instead of gray, anchoring identity without pinning frames (SVI-style anti-drift padding, used by models such as ID-V2V).

images.tooltip: The images to create a video from.

audio.tooltip: The audio to add to the video.

bit_depth.tooltip: Auto uses 8-bit for sRGB and 10-bit for HDR. Explicit 8-bit and 10-bit choices are independent of colorspace.

color_space.tooltip: Colorspace of the input images. HDR selects BT.2020/HLG and HDR PQ selects BT.2020/PQ.

codec.tooltip: Optionally encode the video immediately. None keeps the images in tensor form; Auto uses H.264.

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes.

format.tooltip: The output container. Auto uses MP4 for Auto/H.264 and WebM for AV1. MP4, MKV, and WebM select a specific container.

codec.tooltip: The output video codec. Auto preserves a compatible source stream. H.264 and AV1 re-encoding support SDR, HDR (HLG), and HDR PQ.

encoding.tooltip: Automatic preserves compatible H.264 streams. Re-encode applies custom encoding options.

crf.tooltip: Lower values produce higher quality and larger files.

encoding.tooltip: Automatic preserves compatible AV1 streams. Re-encode applies custom encoding options.

crf.tooltip: Lower values produce higher quality and larger files.

codec.tooltip: The output video codec. Auto preserves a compatible source stream. H.264 and AV1 re-encoding support SDR, HDR (HLG), and HDR PQ.

crf.tooltip: Lower values produce higher quality and larger files.

SaveVideo.name: SaveVideo
SaveVideo.description: Saves the input videos to your ComfyUI output directory.

image.tooltip: Image or video to condition the latent video on. Must be 8*n + 1 frames. If the video is not 8*n + 1 frames, it will be cropped to the nearest 8*n + 1 frames.

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index to start the conditioning at. For single-frame images or videos with 1-8 frames, any frame_idx value is acceptable. For videos with 9+ frames, frame_idx must be divisible by 8, otherwise it will be rounded down to the nearest multiple of 8. Negative values are counted from the end of the video.

attention_mask.tooltip: Optional pixel-space spatial mask. Controls per-region conditioning influence via self-attention, multiplied by strength.

iclora_parameters.tooltip: Optional IC-LoRA parameters from a Get IC-LoRA Parameters node. Used for adjusting guide processing as required by certain IC-LoRAs (eg. those with a reference_downscale_factor > 1). When chained, each LTXVAddGuide uses only the parameters connected to it.

stretch.tooltip: Stretch the sigmas to be in the range [terminal, 1].

terminal.tooltip: The terminal value of the sigmas after stretching.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent audio samples in the batch.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model to get configuration from.

LTXVConcatAVLatent.name: LTXVConcatAVLatent
LTXVConcatAVLatent.description: Merge a video latent and an audio latent into a joint AV latent (any AV model, e.g. LTXV or MiniMax H3).

LTXVSeparateAVLatent.name: LTXVSeparateAVLatent
LTXVSeparateAVLatent.description: Split a joint AV latent into its video and audio latents (any AV model, e.g. LTXV or MiniMax H3).

iclora_model.tooltip: Direct output from a LoRA Loader for the specific IC-LoRA from which to extract the metadata.

output_tooltips: IC-LoRA parameters extracted from the LoRA metadata (eg. reference_downscale_factor). Connect to LTXVAddGuide if the LoRA requires special handling of the guides.
GetICLoRAParameters.name: GetICLoRAParameters
GetICLoRAParameters.description: Extracts IC-LoRA parameters from the safetensors metadata of a LoRA-loaded model and outputs them for LTXVAddGuide (eg. reference_downscale_factor).

video.tooltip: The video to extract components from.

GetVideoComponents.name: GetVideoComponents
GetVideoComponents.description: Extracts video frames, audio, frame rate, bit depth, and color space.

fov_x_degrees.tooltip: Horizontal field of view of the source camera. Sets the focal length used to unproject the depth map into 3D. 0 = auto-recover from the predicted points.

batch_size.tooltip: Images per inference call. Lower if you OOM on a long video / image set.

apply_mask.tooltip: Set masked-out (sky / invalid) pixels to inf in points and depth so meshing culls them. Disable to keep the raw predicted geometry everywhere; the mask is still returned separately.

refine_steps.tooltip: MoGe-3 only: sparse volumetric refinement passes over the predicted depth. More passes sharpen fine detail and edges at a roughly linear cost. 0 disables refinement. Ignored by MoGe-1 / MoGe-2.

MoGeInference.name: MoGeInference
MoGeInference.description: Run MoGe on a single image to estimate depth and geometry.

MoGeGeometryToFOV.name: MoGeGeometryToFOV
MoGeGeometryToFOV.description: Derive the field of view and focal length from MoGe intrinsics.

image.tooltip: Preprocessed image from ImageCropToMask (pad_factor=1.1 for Pixal3D).

camera_angle_x.tooltip: Horizontal FOV in degrees. Wire a MoGeGeometryToFOV (axis='horizontal', unit='degrees') for a per-image FoV (matches upstream default).

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

shape_latent.tooltip: The 512-resolution shape latent output from the first shape-stage KSampler.

target_resolution.tooltip: Voxel resolution of the upsampled shape. Higher = more detail, more VRAM.

shape_subdivides.tooltip: Shape information used to guide higher-detail reconstruction during decoding. Helps preserve structure consistency at higher resolutions.

resolution.tooltip: Voxel grid resolution (output density). 256 ~ 100k faces, 512 ~ 1M. For an exact face count, follow with Decimate Mesh.

sign_mode.tooltip: udf: robust to messy/non-manifold input. sdf: clean single surface with QEF (Quadratic Error Function) sharp-feature recovery, but needs consistent winding.

qef.tooltip: QEF (Quadratic Error Function) dual-vertex placement for sharper edges.

drop_inverted_components.tooltip: Drop inward-normal (negative-volume) closed components — the UDF inner shell.

drop_enclosed_components.tooltip: Drop components inside the largest's bbox that fail a point-in-mesh raycast. Disable for legitimate nested parts.

qef.tooltip: QEF (Quadratic Error Function) dual-vertex placement (recovers sharp features) vs edge-crossing centroid.

manifold.tooltip: Manifold Dual Contouring: 1-4 dual verts/voxel for multi-sheet cases. Slower.

band.tooltip: Narrow-band width in voxel units. In UDF mode also offsets the surface.

project_back.tooltip: Linearly interpolate vertices toward the original surface (0 = pure DC, 1 = snapped).

fix_poles.tooltip: Collapse valence-3 vertex pairs (DC T-junction artifact).

smooth_iters.tooltip: Taubin smoothing iterations (0 = off). 2-3 cleans DC staircase-like artifacts; higher over-smooth QEF edges.

drop_small_components.tooltip: Drop components below this fraction of the largest's face count. 0 disables.

precluster_max_verts.tooltip: Cap input vertex count before the field queries, inputs above this are cluster-decimated to it first. Prevents OOM on huge meshes.

RemeshMesh.name: RemeshMesh
RemeshMesh.description: Re-extracts a uniformly tessellated mesh via a narrow-band distance field + Dual Contouring, on the active compute device. Normalizes messy / non-manifold / self-intersecting topology; run before Decimate Mesh to hit an exact face count. Output stays welded.

line_quadric_weight.tooltip: Per-edge line-quadric weight; preserves sharp ridges/valleys. 0 = off.

feature_edge_quadric_weight.tooltip: Extra quadric weight on dihedral feature edges (creases). 0 = off.

feature_edge_min_dihedral_deg.tooltip: Minimum dihedral angle (degree) to count an edge as a feature edge.

clamp_v_to_edge.tooltip: Project the QEM-optimal position onto the collapsed edge segment.

DecimateMesh.name: DecimateMesh
DecimateMesh.description: Simplifies a mesh to a target face count using QEM, on the active compute device. 'midpoint' is the cumesh-faithful preset (best quality, preserves thin features / hair); 'qem' places vertices at the QEM optimum with line/feature-edge controls. Output stays welded.

crease_angle.tooltip: Edges whose dihedral angle exceeds this value (degrees) stay hard (vertices are split). 180 = fully smooth; lower preserves sharp edges (e.g. ~30-60 for hard-surface).

MeshSmoothNormals.name: MeshSmoothNormals
MeshSmoothNormals.description: Compute smooth per-vertex normals and attach them to the mesh. Meshes without normals are shaded flat (per-face) by glTF viewers; this makes them shade smoothly. With crease_angle below 180, edges sharper than the threshold are kept hard by splitting vertices along them.

segmenter.tooltip: pec: fast parallel-edge-collapse charting on GPU. adaptive: CPU, slower.

resolution.tooltip: Target atlas resolution for texel-density auto-scale (0 = fit-to-content).

weld_distance.tooltip: Coincident-vert merge radius as a fraction of mesh extent (0 = auto). Raise to ~0.001 if you get per-triangle charts (unwelded input).

UnwrapMesh.name: UnwrapMesh
UnwrapMesh.description: Generates a UV atlas: segments the surface into charts, parameterizes each, packs into a [0,1] atlas. Vertices on chart seams are duplicated (one copy per chart, same position, own UV), so the output mesh has more vertices than the input. Run after Remesh/Decimate, before texture baking.

reference_mesh.tooltip: Optional dense pre-decimation mesh; back-projects each texel onto its true surface before sampling, removing faceted baking on coarse meshes.

BakeTextureFromVoxel.name: BakeTextureFromVoxel
BakeTextureFromVoxel.description: Bakes PBR textures onto the mesh's existing UV layout (trilinear-sample the sparse voxel volume). Does NOT unwrap — connect a UV unwrap node upstream. Outputs base_color + metallic/roughness grayscale IMAGEs (black if no PBR); feed them to ApplyTextureToMesh (SAME mesh) for SaveGLB.

samples.tooltip: Rays per texel. More = smoother, slower. Raise if grainy.

max_distance.tooltip: Ray length, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Smaller = tighter, more local occlusion.

bias.tooltip: Ray origin lift off the surface, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Raise if even surfaces show dark blotches/holes.

BakeAmbientOcclusion.name: BakeAmbientOcclusion
BakeAmbientOcclusion.description: Bakes an ambient-occlusion map from a high-poly mesh into a low-poly's UV layout (white = open, dark = crevices). Feed the UV-unwrapped low_poly and the high_poly it was decimated from. Outputs a grayscale image for Apply Texture To Mesh's occlusion input (packed into the ORM map / occlusionTexture).

cage_distance.tooltip: Surface search band, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Raise for wrong/missing patches under heavy decimation; lower if it grabs across gaps.

ignore_backfaces.tooltip: Skip high-poly surfaces facing away from the texel, so crevices/enclosed spaces don't grab the opposite wall. Disable only if the high-poly winding is inconsistent.

BakeNormalMapFromMesh.name: BakeNormalMapFromMesh
BakeNormalMapFromMesh.description: Bakes a tangent-space normal map (glTF/OpenGL +Y) from a high-poly mesh into a low-poly's UV layout, capturing detail lost during decimation. Feed the UV-unwrapped low_poly and the high_poly it was decimated from. Outputs an image for Apply Texture To Mesh's normal_map input.

ApplyTextureToMesh.name: ApplyTextureToMesh
ApplyTextureToMesh.description: Attaches baked texture IMAGEs to a mesh's UV layout for SaveGLB. Feed the SAME mesh you baked

MeshToFile3D.name: MeshToFile3D
MeshToFile3D.description: Serialize a mesh to a GLB File3D object for Save / Preview 3D nodes, carrying its UVs, colors, normals, texture, normal/occlusion/emissive maps and material. Supports one item per batch only.

model_3d.tooltip: 3D model file from an upstream 3D node.

width.tooltip: Render width of the viewport in pixels.

height.tooltip: Render height of the viewport in pixels.

model_3d_info.tooltip: Placement of each model in the scene: position, rotation, and scale (Y-up world space).

camera_info.tooltip: Viewport camera information: position, look-at target, zoom, and type.

output_tooltips: 3D model file (glb/obj/stl/etc.) from an upstream 3D node.
Placement of each model in the scene: position, rotation, and scale (Y-up world space).
Viewport camera information: position, look-at target, zoom, and type.
Render width of the viewport in pixels.
Render height of the viewport in pixels.
Save3DAdvanced.name: Save3DAdvanced

mode.tooltip: What to render. auto: texture if present, else vertex colours, else shaded clay.

model_3d_info.tooltip: Model transform from the same Load3D / Preview3D viewer. Connect it with camera_info to match the viewer framing.

camera_info.tooltip: Camera from a Load3D / Preview3D viewer or a Create Camera Info node. If none is connected, a default front view is auto-framed.

RenderMesh.name: RenderMesh
RenderMesh.description: Ray-casts a single view of a mesh. The camera and optional model transform can come from a Load3D / Preview3D viewer.

CFGOverride.name: CFGOverride
CFGOverride.description: Override cfg to a fixed value over a [start, end] percent (sigma) range. With multiple overrides, the one nearest the sampler wins on overlap.

pad_factor.tooltip: Extra margin around the mask bounding box as a multiplier.

grow_mask.tooltip: Grow or shrink the mask by this many pixels before cropping.

background.tooltip: Background color behind the masked subject.

img_compression.tooltip: Amount of compression to apply on image.

TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus.name: TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus
TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus.display_name: Text Encode Qwen Image Edit Plus

pre_cfg.tooltip: If true, rescale the combined noise BEFORE the sampler's CFG combine, without clamping (can amplify). Matches the norm-scaled CFG used by models like Lens. Default false keeps the original post-CFG x0-space attenuate-only behavior.

video_frame_offset.tooltip: The amount of frames to seek in all the input videos. Used for generating longer videos by chunk. Connect to the video_frame_offset output of the previous node for extending a video.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model to use for encoding.

width.tooltip: The width of the latent images in pixels.

height.tooltip: The height of the latent images in pixels.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

EmptyLatentImage.name: EmptyLatentImage
EmptyLatentImage.description: Create a new batch of empty latent images to be denoised via sampling.

batch_index.tooltip: Which image of a batched MoGe geometry to mesh. Per-image vertex counts differ, so batches can't be stacked into a single MESH.

discontinuity_threshold.tooltip: Drop pixels whose 3x3 depth span exceeds this fraction. 0 = off.

texture.tooltip: Carry the source image through as the baseColor texture.

MoGePointMapToMesh.name: MoGePointMapToMesh
MoGePointMapToMesh.display_name: Convert MoGe Point Map to Mesh
MoGePointMapToMesh.description: Convert a MoGe point map into a 3D mesh.

output.tooltip: DirectX vs OpenGL controls the normal-map green-channel convention. DirectX: green = -Y down (Unreal). OpenGL: green = +Y up (Blender, Substance, Unity, glTF).

MoGeRender.name: MoGeRender
MoGeRender.description: Render a depth map or normal map from geometry data

temporal_size.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to encode at a time.

temporal_overlap.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to overlap.

output_tooltips: The padded image for VAE encoding.
SeedVR2Preprocess.name: SeedVR2Preprocess
SeedVR2Preprocess.description: Pad a resized image for SeedVR2 model. Alpha channel is dropped. The node Post-Process SeedVR2 Output re-applies it from the original resized image.

SeedVR2Conditioning.name: SeedVR2Conditioning
SeedVR2Conditioning.description: Build SeedVR2 positive/negative conditioning from a VAE latent.

original_resized_images.tooltip: The original resized image before pre-processing, used as reference.

color_correction_method.tooltip: Method to match the generated image colors to the original image. lab: transfer color in CIELAB space, preserving detail (most faithful). wavelet: transfer low-frequency color, keeping upscaled high-frequency detail. adain: match per-channel mean/std (fastest, global tint). none: skip color transfer (geometry alignment only).

SeedVR2PostProcessing.name: SeedVR2PostProcessing
SeedVR2PostProcessing.description: Align the generated image with the original resized image and apply color correction.
